Define cohort inclusion/exclusion rules (attrition)

Source: R/cohort.R
attrition.Rd

Each named argument is one attrition rule — a Group built with withAll, withAny, withAtLeast, or withAtMost. Rules are applied in order after the index event is selected.

attrition(..., expressionLimit = c("First", "All", "Last"))

Arguments

...

Named Group objects, each representing one inclusion or exclusion rule.

expressionLimit

Which qualifying events per person survive attrition — "First" (default), "All", or "Last". Should align with primaryCriteriaLimit in entry.

Value

A CohortAttrition object.

See also

cohort, entry, withAll, withAny

Examples

t2dm <- cs(descendants(201826L), name = "T2DM")
attrition(
  noT2DM = withAll(exactly(0, conditionOccurrence(t2dm),
                           duringInterval(eventStarts(-Inf, 0)))),
  expressionLimit = "First"
)
